title: Complete a task from its agent branch
summary: Close the gap after an agent run: review the branch, merge it once the story's evals pass on the merged result, mark the task done and clean up; warn when related tasks run in parallel.
rationale: TASK-0033..0037 finished their agent runs but stayed in-progress: nothing reviewed, merged or completed them, and three dependent tasks ran in parallel on separate branches.

data.title: Complete task from agent branch
data.statement: The system shall let a user complete a task whose agent branch is ready by reviewing it, merging it after the story's evals pass on the merged result, and marking the task done in 1 action.
data.rationale: Agent work otherwise stays on local branches and tasks never reach done.

acceptance_criteria.text: The task drawer lists the agent branch's commits and changed files and shows its diff against the merge base
Complete is refused, with the reason shown, while the component checkout has uncommitted changes outside the requirements folder
Complete first merges the checked-out branch into the task branch in its worktree; on conflict it aborts, leaves both branches unchanged and lists the conflicting files
The story's evals then run in the task worktree; Complete is refused while any of them fails, listing the failing evals and their output tail
On success the task branch is merged into the checked-out branch with --no-ff, the task becomes done, and its worktree and branch are removed, within 1 action
When the last open task of a story is completed the story becomes done, and the epic when all its stories are done
Start with agent warns, before confirmation, about other in-progress tasks of the same story with unmerged agent branches and offers to add them to depends_on

data.title: Complete a task from its agent branch
data.narrative: As a product owner, I want to review an agent's branch and complete the task in one action so that verified work lands on the main branch and the task is done.

data.title: Complete-flow design: merge order, eval run, cleanup, parallel-task warning
data.description: Extend docs/agent-runs.md with the complete flow: preconditions, merge of main into the task branch, eval run in the worktree, --no-ff merge, status cascade to story/epic, cleanup, and the parallel-task warning.

data.title: Complete endpoint in the server
data.description: GET tasks/{id}/branch (commits, files, diff) and POST tasks/{id}/complete implementing AC2-AC6; parallel-branch warning in the agent plan (AC7).

data.title: Review & complete UI in the task drawer
data.description: Branch review (commits, files, diff), Complete button with refusal reasons and eval output, parallel-task warning in the agent confirmation dialog.

impact_notes.stories: New STORY in EPIC-0010; no existing story changes.
impact_notes.code: server: taskflow/agent (complete endpoint, branch review); web: task drawer.
impact_notes.evals: task_complete integration tests and a task-complete e2e suite.
risks: Merging into the checked-out branch changes the user's working copy; refuse when it has uncommitted changes.
